title: Electrospinning of gelatin/waterborne polyurethane blends: parameter window for stable fibers
text: Stable electrospinning was achieved at 15–22 kV using polymer solutions in the range 8–14 wt%. Outside this window, bead formation increased and fiber uniformity decreased.

title: Humidity effects in electrospinning of hydrophilic polymers
text: At around 18 kV, humidity strongly influenced jet stability. We recommend keeping concentration near 12 wt% when operating at 16–20 kV for reproducible fiber diameters.

title: Porous organic materials: trade-offs between surface area and yield
text: Synthetic routes that maximize surface area can reduce yield. Multi-objective optimisation is required to balance surface area with isolated yield under temperature and solvent constraints.

title: Electrospinning notes: voltage and concentration ranges for composite nanofibers
text: Composite fibers were spun successfully over 10–24 kV. Concentrations of 7–16 wt% supported continuous fibers for the studied polymer blends.
